seo_title: Pizza for a crowd, delivered to Baikonyr — Frnds
seo_description: Pizza for the whole crowd from Frnds: dough matured for two days, boxes arriving hot in branded thermal bags. WhatsApp +7 707 480 92 15, daily 09:00–23:00.
h1: Pizza for the whole crew in Baikonyr — no need to haul it yourself anymore
body:
The evening when your people gather always starts the same way: the flat is already loud, the fridge is silent. There's no time to cook, and you can't feed your own crowd just anything — these aren't strangers. At Frnds we consider evenings like that the most important ones of the week, and we pack food for them by the box: several different pizzas cut up for the shared table, everyone finds exactly their slice, and the only argument left is about the film. Tested over dozens of Fridays — our own, at that very communal table.

Our pizza handles the road with dignity, and that's not luck, it's method. The dough matures for two full days: slow, cold fermentation keeps the crust alive and springy, so the ride to the other end of the city doesn't scare it. To the pizzas people usually add pasta — for that one person in every crowd who doesn't eat pizza — and desserts, remembered only at the till. Tell us how many of you are gathering, and we'll suggest how many boxes it takes to feed everyone and still leave something for the morning.

And now the change that rewrote everything for Baikonyr: you don't have to carry the order across the bridge yourself anymore. Frnds has its own delivery — the boxes ride in branded thermal bags and arrive hot, however many of them there are. Message WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 with how many people and by what time, and spend the evening with your guests instead of the steering wheel. Prefer the old way? Pickup hasn't gone anywhere: say when you'll pull up, and the order will be waiting for you, packed.

Our slogan translates as 'we cook for friends', and an evening like yours is exactly that — just with the table set on the other side of the river. We're at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, open every day from nine in the morning to eleven at night: in time for Friday gatherings, for Sunday's match, and for a sudden 'everyone come over to ours'. What's coming out of the oven today is on Instagram at @frnds.kz. Set the table and call your people — the rest will arrive on its own.
landmarks: Coming from the Saryarka mall or the old centre, your way lies over the bridge to the left bank, into the Esil district: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, the Frnds sign. Our courier, though, knows that road without any landmarks.
cta: Gather your people and message WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 — the boxes will arrive hot, or everything will be packed for your arrival.
